input.reply_markdown:
Sorry about the repeated sign-in prompts — this is a known issue after a password change, and usually easy to fix:

1. Close the sign-in box, then close Outlook completely.
2. Try signing in to webmail in your browser with your new password, to confirm the new password is working there.
3. Check your laptop has a working internet connection (and is on VPN if you're remote and need it for mail).
4. Open Outlook again and sign in once. If prompted, approve the MFA request.
5. If the box keeps coming back, sign out of your work account in your operating system's account settings, restart the laptop, and sign in again.
6. On Windows, you can also open Credential Manager, remove any saved entries with the mail server or Outlook in the name, then restart Outlook.

One more thing worth checking: if you also use Outlook on your phone, make sure it has been updated with the new password too — an old password still saved there is a common cause of this loop.

If the prompt still keeps returning after these steps, please reply with your Outlook version, whether webmail works, and confirm your phone's mail app has the new password, so we can look further.
input.reasoning_summary: KB-024 directly covers Outlook repeatedly prompting for a password, including the exact scenario of this starting right after a password change, so it fully addresses the reported problem.
